name: The survivor
description:
The one body in the game, and the only thing on the field that is not the hive. A sealed sphere of shell with the same organ every creature out there carries, `dead`: no halo, no bloom, a hairline crack across cold grey. That silence is the entire premise — it is why the hive comes, and it is the whole reason there is a game. There used to be eight of these, one per playable character; the roster became draughts instead, so what a run varies is what this body drank, not which body it is.

The feelers are drawn at nearly twice the length the old shells gave them. With one body they are the only silhouette the player ever learns, and the game is called The Feelers — so the feature the title names should be the feature you can pick out. They are also the joke: two long, beautifully sensitive antennae, sweeping an empty band.

Not in use. The game ships the eight `ss.char.dot`…`ss.char.hex` shells and reads them by id, so removing them to make room for this one took the roster out from under a consumer that was still asking for it — the pin simply had not moved yet, which hid it. They are back; this stays because the draught roster it belongs to may yet land, and an unused document costs a render. **Do not delete the eight to tidy this up.** Whichever way that decision goes, the art goes second: the game stops asking for an id before the id stops existing, never the other way round.

idle.description: the shell holds its breath; the dead feelers keep sweeping for a signal that never comes
